description.value: Discovery Coffee is a locally owned specialty coffee roaster and cafe headquartered in Victoria, BC, roasting all of its beans in-house and offering house blends alongside single-origin lots from Peru and Rwanda. The brand has grown to operate multiple cafe locations in the city and partners with Yonni's Doughnuts for baked goods. Cyclists stopping in will find a craft-focused espresso bar with an accompanying online retail operation for beans and brewing gear.
